note: Generic formats in Crewcut's own words, without images. Your own library in brand/references/formats/formats.json adds to these and replaces formats with the same id.

formats.name: Face points at the result
formats.recipe: The person large in the left or right third, turned to one large real result and pointing at it; one to three words; at most one number in a box; one product logo.
formats.fits: The default image of the channel; any video with a visible result.

formats.name: Result against result
formats.recipe: Split in the middle, two equal halves, each a real result with its logo; the one number on the winner's side; no 'vs' between the halves.
formats.fits: The video really compares two results of the same test.

formats.name: Before and after
formats.recipe: The state before and after side by side, the after larger and brighter.

formats.name: Progress in stages
formats.recipe: Three or four real stages from left to right, each a bit larger, short labels, the last one in the accent box.
formats.fits: The video shows rounds or steps.

formats.name: Two-word command
formats.recipe: Face large on one side with a strong expression; on the other side two words in heavy capitals, the second on a coloured box. Nothing else.
formats.fits: A method or a person the viewer should copy; a short imperative carries the video.

formats.name: Hype line beside the face
formats.recipe: One emotional line in huge type beside the face, a tiny sub-line on a box under it; dark ground.
formats.fits: A surprising result the video proves.

formats.name: Into the trash
formats.recipe: One recognisable object (file, app tile, logo) falling into a bin; the person beside it, thoughtful, hand at the chin; a short line like 'Don't use' with an arrow to the object.
formats.fits: Replacing a habit, tool or file the viewer still uses.

formats.name: One big object
formats.recipe: One oversized object with a label (folder, card, device) in the lower half; the person beside it; two words above with a curved arrow to the object.
formats.fits: A set of things to copy or install.

formats.name: Tombstone
formats.recipe: A tombstone with the old thing's name on it; the person smirking beside it or the brand name in big type on the other side.
formats.fits: Something old is replaced by something new.

formats.name: Leaning back, it is over
formats.recipe: The person leans back relaxed, hands behind the head, the laptop in front does the work; one short line with an arrow to the screen.
formats.fits: Automation: the machine now does the job.

formats.name: Old against new
formats.recipe: Face in the middle; on one side the old tool with a red cross, on the other the new one with a green check; two labels 'old' and 'new' at the top.
formats.fits: Switching from one way or tool to another.

formats.name: Meter in the interface
formats.recipe: One large interface element (a limit bar, a progress meter, a counter) beside the face, showing a measured state; two to three words above.
formats.fits: Limits, costs, speed or usage, with a real value.

formats.name: Face plus rising curve
formats.recipe: A single curve rising across the image behind or beside the face, the end point marked; one or two words.
formats.fits: Growth or improvement with a measured result.

formats.name: Grid of concepts
formats.recipe: A clean grid of six to twelve simple icons or tiles, no face or a small face; one caption.

formats.name: Logo equation
formats.recipe: Logo plus logo equals a result, in big symbols across the image; the person small or absent.
formats.fits: Combining two tools into one result.

formats.name: Face between two logos
formats.recipe: The person at a laptop in the middle, one large logo on each side, a short verdict line on top.
formats.fits: A head-to-head test of two tools.

formats.name: Quote with one word underlined
formats.recipe: A short quote in quotation marks over the lower part of the image, one word underlined in the accent colour; the face above it.
formats.fits: A bold claim the video backs up.

formats.name: Giant number behind the head
formats.recipe: One huge measured number across the top, partly behind the head; nothing else.
formats.fits: Money or a measured amount is the point of the video.

formats.name: Headline plus reaction still
formats.recipe: Two to three words in heavy capitals on the left, a reaction picture on the right.
